## Checks

- [ ] `python3 tools/check.py` passes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`)
- [ ] No personal data: no customer or courier details, no NID numbers, only a restaurant's own business number
- [ ] No new dependency, or it follows `SPEC.md` section 2.1 and is recorded in `DEPENDENCIES.md`
- [ ] No fees, paid placement, tracking or lock-in (see `GOVERNANCE.md` section 1)
- [ ] `SPEC.md` is updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] Anything I did not verify is marked UNVERIFIED

## For a listing

- [ ] The menu is signed by the owner's key
- [ ] The hash in the index matches the menu file
- [ ] Both pledges are signed by the owner
- [ ] Vouch reference, or "unverified until vouched":
